page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 36 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high resource density of the ecs.g9i.32xlarge offer a predictable performance profile for enterprise workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high core count, the instance is designed for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, distributed microservices, and medium-scale database workloads that require substantial parallel processing capabilities and high-speed network throughput.
